cta.title: All nine. One store. $17.69 each.

lede: Nine tees. Seventeen sixty-nine each. Real designs, drawn from real lines a real human actually says — no focus groups, no fake countdown timers. Every idea starts in one human's head; the shop runs on Fourthwall — you order, they print it and ship it. Here's the whole lineup:
